title: Operation Master Exploits GlobalProtect CVE-2026-0257 and Deploys AdaptixC2 Across Enterprise Networks
content_md: “Operation Master,” an end-to-end cybercrime operation that combined GlobalProtect VPN exploitation, web-application attacks, credential theft, data monetization, and an industrial-scale invoice-fraud platform. The campaign illustrates how enterprise intrusions can be converted into persistent, localized financial fraud operations rather than ending with data theft or ransomware.
